observation.visible_scene: A top-down static shot of a wooden floor with a large spiral arrangement of dominoes. The spiral has a colored inner loop (green and blue standing dominoes) and a longer outer loop of white standing dominoes. To the left is a separate, already-flattened chain (a horizontal line plus a small loop). At the start, a short stretch of the outer loop at the lower-left already lies flat.
visible_changes: The flat, fallen portion of the outer spiral loop lengthens as its leading edge travels clockwise: from the lower-left (~7-8 o'clock) across the bottom (~6 o'clock), up the right side (~3 o'clock), and to roughly the upper-right (~1-2 o'clock) by the last frame.
White dominoes ahead of the moving front stand upright; once the front passes, they appear as a continuous flat pale line.
The inner colored (green/blue) spiral loop stays standing and unchanged throughout the excerpt.
The left-side separate chain remains in its already-fallen flat state with no visible change.
The camera and background wood grain are fixed; all change is object motion, not camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: The initial trigger or earlier impact that started the outer-loop cascade and the left chain (already in progress at frame 1).
Whether the cascade will reach the inner colored spiral or terminate before it.
The outcome after the last frame.
uncertain_details: The exact physical connection between the left chain and the outer spiral tail.
Small blue/white tint variations at the falling front, which may be edge/lighting effects rather than separate objects.
